name: TopGear
blockers: IMAP references use different record layouts (FM5 8 bytes; FH2 7 bytes plus a counted additional model-mapping array); FH2 also has additional spatial/procedural lookup tables that this tool has not decoded. A header-only patch does not convert geometry references.
FM5 geometry and textures are in bin.zip; the FH2 reference uses GeoChunk/ChunkMap streaming. The legacy loading path and required dependency mapping are not verified.
Shader filename matches do not establish compatible material parameters or compiled shaders.
FH2 navigation, spawn/arrival and native custom-track selection are not implemented or tested.
pvs_note: FH2 native serializers retain legacy version branches, including version 50. Do not rewrite the version to 60 without converting its payload.
fts_note: ForzaTechStudio documentation describes car/model/texture conversion, not a full track/world/navigation conversion.
